BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
be amended by changing all the RS3 Residential Single-Unit District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 8-F in the area bounded by

West 32" Street; South Wallace Street; a line 25 feet south of and parallel

to West 32™ Street; a Public Alley west of and parallel to South Wallace
Street;

to those of a C1-1 Neighborhood Commercial District is hereby established in the

area above described.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and

due publication.

Common Address of Property: 3200 South Wallace Street
